note: One plain line per tile family id in strike-bank.json: the move, then the fix. Shown only to the player, on this device, after seven Strikes. No Codex name.

s01.move: Keeping the same sign after dividing by a negative.
s01.fix: A negative flips the sign. Test one number to be sure.

s02.move: Doing a step to part of an expression instead of all of it.
s02.fix: Whatever you do to one term, do to every term on both sides.

s03.move: Picking an answer that claims more than the text can back.
s03.fix: Words like prove, always and cause need strong proof. A careful text usually says suggest or may.

s04.move: Picking the answer that repeats the text's words.
s04.fix: Matching words is not matching meaning. Check what the choice actually claims.

s05.move: Answering a question the test didn't ask.
s05.fix: Before you pick, reread the last line of the question and check the choice answers that line.

s06.move: Reading a point on the line as the y-intercept.
s06.fix: The y-intercept is the y-value at x = 0. Find the slope, then use one point to get b.

s07.move: Picking a transition word before naming how the two ideas connect.
s07.fix: Say the link in plain words first, like but, so or also, then find the word that means that.

s08.move: Joining two full sentences with only a comma.
s08.fix: If both halves can stand alone, they need a period, a semicolon, or a comma plus and, but or so.

s09.move: Dropping a minus sign when moving or subtracting a term.
s09.fix: Taking away a negative adds. Carry every sign with its number.

s10.move: Putting commas around words the sentence needs.
s10.fix: If the sentence loses its meaning without the words, leave the commas out.

s11.move: Putting a colon after words that aren't a full sentence.
s11.fix: A colon needs a complete sentence before it.

s12.fix: Check what the question asks for. Solving for x is often step one, not the answer.

s13.fix: An absolute value or a square can hide two answers. Spot the shape before you solve.

s14.move: Matching a verb or pronoun to the nearest noun.
s14.fix: Find the real subject. Skip the words in between and match to that.

s15.move: Picking a verb tense the sentence's time words don't allow.
s15.fix: Find the time clue, like last spring or by then, and match the tense to it.

s16.move: Reading off the angle that's given instead of the one asked for.
s16.fix: Write each angle you know on the figure, then step from it to the one asked for.

s17.move: Using a word's everyday meaning when the text uses another one.
s17.fix: Hide the word, read the sentence, and pick the meaning the sentence needs.

s18.move: Reading the wrong row or column of a table.
s18.fix: Put a finger on the row and the column the question names, and read where they meet.

s19.move: Letting a rise and a drop of the same size cancel.
s19.fix: Each change works on a new number, so run them one at a time.

s20.move: Picking a sentence that tells the reader what they already know.
s20.fix: Check who the writer is talking to and what that reader still needs.

s21.move: Picking a true sentence that doesn't do the job the question asks for.
s21.fix: Read the goal in the question first, then pick the choice that meets it.

s22.move: Guessing how many times two graphs meet.
s22.fix: Graph both and count the points where they cross.

s23.fix: If the words run as one sentence, no mark is often right.

s24.move: Reading something from a chart that it doesn't show.
s24.fix: Name what the chart shows, like a median or a count, and stop there.

s25.move: Picking an idea the passage already ruled out.
s25.fix: Cross out each choice the evidence knocks down. Pick what's left.

s26.move: Pairing numbers in the wrong order.
s26.fix: Line up x with x and y with y before you compare.

s27.move: Picking a purpose the text never takes on.
s27.fix: Say what the text does in one line, then match that.

s28.move: Mixing up what each number in an equation stands for.
s28.fix: Ask what changes with x and what stays fixed. The number next to x is the rate.

s29.move: Picking a choice that is only half right.
s29.fix: Every part of a choice has to hold up. One wrong half sinks it.

s30.move: Starting to solve before naming the unknowns.
s30.fix: Write what each letter stands for first, then build the equation.

s31.move: Picking evidence on the right topic that doesn't prove the claim.
s31.fix: Ask whether the finding shows the exact claim, not just the subject.

s32.move: Treating growth that multiplies as growth that adds.
s32.fix: Doubling three times is times 2, times 2, times 2.

s33.move: Picking a word that sounds right but runs against the clue.
s33.fix: Find the clue in the sentence, predict a word, then match.

s34.move: Moving a graph the wrong way.
s34.fix: Inside the parentheses it flips: x minus 5 moves right, x plus 5 moves left.

s35.move: Putting a question mark on a sentence that only reports a question.
s35.fix: If the sentence tells about a question rather than asking it, end with a period.

s36.fix: Find the group the question picks from. That group goes on the bottom.

s37.move: Using one rate for everyone when the rate changes at a cutoff.
s37.fix: Split at the cutoff and work out each part on its own.

s38.move: Giving a claim to the wrong person in the text.
s38.fix: Mark who says what, then match the claim to its owner.

s39.fix: With exponents, the numbers in front multiply and the powers add.

s40.move: Mixing up the sine and cosine of the two acute angles.
s40.fix: The sine of one acute angle is the cosine of the other. The numbers stay the same.

s41.move: Picking a sentence with no real verb for its subject.
s41.fix: Find the subject, then check it has its own verb.

s42.move: Picking any value in a range when the question wants one number.
s42.fix: Check whether the question wants one exact value or anything in the range.

s43.move: Scaling area by the same factor as the sides.
s43.fix: Area scales by the square. Triple the sides and the area grows 9 times.

s44.move: Averaging two means as if the groups were the same size.
s44.fix: Weight each mean by the size of its group.

s45.move: Expecting the median to move when one extreme value changes.
s45.fix: An extreme value pulls the mean. The median moves only if the middle moves.

s46.move: Mixing up no solution and infinitely many.
s46.fix: Same x terms and same constants: infinitely many. Same x terms, new constants: none.

s47.move: Undoing steps in the wrong order when isolating a letter.
s47.fix: Undo the outermost step first. Clear the fraction before you move terms.

s48.move: Missing a small word like some or most.
s48.fix: Underline the qualifier and make sure the choice keeps it.
